text: I request the Vice President, Human Resources and Transformation, Toronto Parking Authority, to provide a confidential update to the Board on employment matters for the former Toronto Parking Authority employees identified in the report entitled "Auditor General's Observations of a Land Acquisition at Finch Avenue West and Arrow Road by the Toronto Parking Authority".

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions taken in closed session in issuing confidential instructions to the Vice President, Human Resources and Transformation, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Requested the Vice President, Human Resources and Transformation, Toronto Parking Authority, to provide a confidential update to the Board on employment matters for the former Toronto Parking Authority employees identified in the report entitled "Auditor General's Observations of a Land Acquisition at Finch Avenue West and Arrow Road by the Toronto Parking Authority".
